subject: [PATCH v9 6/7] mm/memcontrol: add stock to the memsw page counter

2026-11-13.patch_summary: This patch adds a stock to the memsw page counter in the Linux kernel's memory control module (mm/memcontrol.c). The new stock allows for independent handling of memory and swap counters, enabling them to be charged, refilled, drained, and hotplugged separately. This change also introduces a common drain scheduling function, schedule_stock_drain(), which is used by both stocks. If memory charging fails, the patch rolls back only the number of pages from memsw, leaving any batch surplus cached in the stock. The separate banks can now operate independently, allowing their raw counters to temporarily drift due to cached amounts.
